Every change on this row is attested, but the row is held for a pattern across rows. The door has six 'What number is N more than X?' rows (MC01/03/04/05-NPV-02/03). The LIVE template already puts the key second-largest on 5 of 6, with the +1000 lure always on top. Signing all five re-proposed rows would put the key LARGEST on 6 of 6, so 'pick the biggest' scores every time. That is the shortcut this repair exists to remove, moved to a single question template where the door measure cannot see it. I signed two (MC01-NPV-02 and MC04-NPV-03), leaving 3 of 6 largest and 3 of 6 second-largest. This row can be re-proposed as a retag only, as MC03-NPV-03 was: 63 -> 61 on the -10/-100 option; the +1000 or +10,000 option is genuinely #61 too, one column LEFT. That would correct its tags without moving its rank.
